name: v0.21.0
body:
## Highlights

- Add Anthropic Claude as a translation provider through framework-neutral model client adapters.
- Add a README-first translation pull request workflow and preserve human edits through translation state providers.
- Review uncommitted source changes before translation updates are committed.
- Reduce CLI startup work and remove Matplotlib from the runtime dependency set.
- Add a no-code translation feedback path and clearer onboarding for multilingual contributors.

## What's Changed

* Docs: Reframe README around real-world translation maintenance by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/521
* Build: Modernize Python support and dependencies by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/522
* Core: Add framework-neutral model client adapters by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/524
* Core: Add Anthropic Claude provider support by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/525
* Core: Add a README-first translation PR workflow by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/526
* Docs: Restore the legacy supported languages entry point by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/528
* Docs: Add optional translation onboarding links to README guidance by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/529
* Build(deps): Bump werkzeug from 3.1.1 to 3.1.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/523
* Docs: Add a no-code language contribution pathway by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/530
* Docs: Use a Japanese community report in the contribution guide by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/531
* Docs: Add multilingual Microsoft learning repositories by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/532
* Build: Fix dependency and documentation CI failures by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/533
* Core: Preserve human Markdown edits with translation state providers by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/536
* Core: Review uncommitted source changes by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/538
* Build: Remove automatic Co-op review check by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/539
* Build: Remove Matplotlib runtime dependency by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/535
* Core: Load CLI command implementations on demand by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/534
* Docs: Document Anthropic provider setup by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/537
* Build: Bump version to 0.21.0 by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/540

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/compare/v0.20.1...v0.21.0
